# Lab 13.8: Multimodal Analysis

## What We Are Going to Do
Ask Gemini about images, PDFs, audio and video stored in Cloud Storage, using object tables and ObjectRef values in SQL.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Describe images.** Uses `lab10.pet_images` from Lab 10.6.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT uri,
  AI.GENERATE(('Describe this product photo in 12 words and name its colour: ', OBJ.GET_ACCESS_URL(ref, 'r')),
              output_schema =&gt; 'description STRING, colour STRING').*
  EXCEPT (full_response, status)
FROM lab10.pet_images
LIMIT 5;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] Read PDFs.** Replace `YOUR_PROJECT`.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE EXTERNAL TABLE lab13.pdfs
WITH CONNECTION `YOUR_PROJECT.us.lab_conn`
OPTIONS (object_metadata = 'SIMPLE', uris = ['gs://cloud-samples-data/generative-ai/pdf/*.pdf']);

SELECT uri, AI.GENERATE(('Give the title and a 2-line summary of this document: ', OBJ.GET_ACCESS_URL(ref, 'r'))).result AS summary
FROM lab13.pdfs LIMIT 3;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[SQL] Audio and video.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE EXTERNAL TABLE lab13.audio
WITH CONNECTION `YOUR_PROJECT.us.lab_conn`
OPTIONS (object_metadata = 'SIMPLE', uris = ['gs://cloud-samples-data/generative-ai/audio/*.mp3']);

SELECT uri, AI.GENERATE(('What is this audio about? Answer in one sentence: ', OBJ.GET_ACCESS_URL(ref, 'r'))).result AS topic
FROM lab13.audio LIMIT 3;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Videos work the same way. Only the first 2 minutes of a video are analysed.

4. **[CLI] Let the connection read the sample bucket if needed.** Public sample buckets are readable by everyone; for your own bucket grant `roles/storage.objectViewer` to the connection's service account (Lab 10.3).

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Images | Description and colour as columns |
| PDFs | Title and summary |
| Audio / video | Topic in one sentence |
| Input | `OBJ.GET_ACCESS_URL(ref, 'r')` in the prompt |
